description: Domain registration record from RDAP, the registry's raw record (registrar, registration/expiry dates, nameservers, status) plus a normalised `summary` block that also follows the registrar's own record: registrar abuse email/phone, IANA id, registrant name/organisation/country with registrant_status (published / redacted / not_published_by_registry), DNSSEC. A throttled or unreachable registry returns registered:null with a note, never an empty body; a "domain not found" answer means the name is UNREGISTERED (available to register, subject to registrar checks). Keyless and authoritative (the registry's own service; the modern replacement for WHOIS). Covers gTLDs and ccTLDs including .io, .me, .de, .us, .ch, .sh and .ac, which IANA's bootstrap file omits. PREFER for "who is the registrar for <domain>", "when does <domain> expire", "who owns <domain>", "WHOIS for <domain>", "is <domain>.com available/registered".

base.description: Optional registry RDAP base URL, e.g. "https://rdap.verisign.com/com/v1". Skips IANA bootstrap lookup, use it when a TLD comes back as tld_not_in_iana_bootstrap and you know the registry endpoint.

name.description: Domain name, e.g. "openai.com". Also accepted as `domain`.
